title: Odd-level Fourier coefficients of majority
statement: Let $m,j$ be nonnegative integers, and let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates in the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$ with $|S|=2j+1$. The absolute Fourier coefficient of majority on $S$ equals $\frac{\binom{m}{j}}{\binom{2m}{2j}}$ times the odd-majority influence in dimension parameter $m$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinates in dimension $2m+1$
